description: This file contains utility functions for determining if a network host address is a loopback or private LAN address on Android devices. It includes methods to check for IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses, local network addresses, and detection of emulator environments based on device build information.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if the provided host string represents a loopback address (IPv4 or IPv6) on Android devices.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if the host string corresponds to a private LAN address, including local and link-local addresses.
